summary: Conley pledged continued US military support for Israel and distanced herself from blocking arms sales, while opposing Netanyahu's government and supporting a two-state solution. She told Jewish Insider she would back the Antisemitism Awareness Act. At an October 2026 debate she condemned antisemitism after repeated questioning. Sarsour called her '100% pro-Israel,' and she carries campaign-claimed endorsements from DMFI PAC and JDCA. Her position centers the US-Israel alliance with limited acknowledgment of Palestinian justice.
